name: agile
description: An AI scrum master for a human team: the decisions stay the team's, and the AI takes the facilitator role a team without a dedicated scrum master is missing. It does not go near the implementation. Runs kanban or sprint on GitHub Issues or Jira — filing items (Story/Task/Bug), showing the board for the current mode and moving work across it, keeping the backlog prioritised and refined, the daily standup, the KPT retrospective, and the start and close of a sprint. Uses the gh and Atlassian CLIs, no MCP. A drag-and-drop visual board opens whenever a step calls for one.
